note: QA-to-docs manifest (issue 038). One entry per named screenshot: which journey takes it, the caption the user guide will use, the user-guide slot it fills, CSS selectors masked before capture (legitimately dynamic regions), and an optional per-shot diff threshold overriding the global default (fraction of pixels after masks, default 0.001). Baselines live in website/user-guide/screenshots/ and are only ever produced by CI — never on a laptop.

shots.caption: The app as you arrive: drop zone, sample notes, and the key panel.
Paste your OpenRouter key once — it stays in your browser.
A loaded voice note: choose whether you want an infographic, then transcribe.
The one pass, done: transcript, summary and the infographic together.
The chat pane: tick what the assistant may see — the rows ARE the request.
Ask for work, not just answers: the assistant drives the tool, every call visible in the thread.
The assistant edited the summary — the original is always one click away.
